summary: Sheriff's deputies arrested a man Monday on a charge of shooting into an occupied building, and Loxley police booked a woman on a family-assault charge. The jail roster shows 17 criminal bookings dated Nov. 2 and four so far on Nov. 3, including three drunk-driving arrests.

entries.title: Shooting into occupied building arrest: Jason Cameron Chandler
body: Jason Cameron Chandler, 23, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 7:31 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on a charge of shooting into an occupied building — firing a gun into a building with people inside. The roster shows him released Tuesday, Nov. 3. The sheriff's office has not posted details of the arrest.

entries.title: Family assault arrest: Tamara Sommer Carbo
body: Loxley police arrested Tamara Sommer Carbo, 50, at 11:50 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, according to the jail roster.
She was booked on a charge of assault on a family or household member with a weapon other than a firearm. She was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Reckless endangerment arrest: Joseph Shawn Tucker III
body: Joseph Shawn Tucker III, 56, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 9:09 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, and booked Monday, Nov. 2, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on charges of reckless endangerment — conduct creating a substantial risk of serious injury to another person — and harassment of a family or household member. He was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Sex offender registration arrest: Brian Thomas Pendleton
body: Brian Thomas Pendleton, 46, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 12:52 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on two counts of failure of an adult sex offender to register with local law enforcement or comply with residence restrictions. He was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Drunk-driving arrests: three booked Nov. 2–3
body: State troopers arrested Tina Marie Whittington St Clair, 53, at 5:10 p.m. Monday, Nov. 2, on a charge of driving under the influence of a controlled substance, according to the jail roster. She was in custody when the roster was read.

Sheriff's deputies arrested Janessa Leigh Peden, 29, at 10:26 a.m. Monday on charges of driving under the influence of alcohol and failure to signal; she was released the same day. Deputies arrested Anthony Jermaine Hale, 49, at 11:05 p.m. Monday on a charge of driving under the influence of alcohol; he was booked early Tuesday and was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Drug and theft arrests: Walter Gulley III, Kelly David Stinson, Christopher Fitzgerald Salter
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Walter Gulley III, 44, at 11:18 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, on charges of possession of dangerous drugs and second-degree marijuana possession, according to the jail roster. Kelly David Stinson, 45, arrested at 3:20 p.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, and booked Monday, was booked on charges of sale or possession of unlawful hemp products and possession of dangerous drugs; he was released Monday.
Deputies also arrested Christopher Fitzgerald Salter, 58, on Monday on a charge of third-degree theft of property. Gulley and Salter were in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Bay Minette arrests: Joyce Gwendoyln Williams, Tydaydra Dominique Carter
body: Bay Minette police arrested Joyce Gwendoyln Williams, 26, at 11 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, on charges of harassing communications and criminal mischief — damaging another person's property — according to the jail roster. She was released the same day.

Police arrested Tydaydra Dominique Carter, 32, at 2:14 p.m. Monday on a charge of third-degree criminal trespass — entering or staying on property unlawfully. She was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Burglary arrest: Andrew James Crenshaw Jr
body: Andrew James Crenshaw Jr., 38, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 12:39 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, according to the jail roster.

The roster now lists his booked charge as burglary of a residence with force — entering a home unlawfully, by force, to commit a crime. When the roster was read Monday it showed a charge of failure to appear on a felony. He was in custody when the roster was read.

entries.title: Drug possession arrest: Jeffery Thomas Whaley
body: Jeffery Thomas Whaley, 55, was arrested by sheriff's deputies at 11:19 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, according to the jail roster.

He was booked on two counts of possession of dangerous drugs — possessing a controlled substance without a prescription. He was in custody when the roster was read Tuesday. The sheriff's office has not posted details of the arrest.

entries.title: False identity and hindering arrests: Brandy Leanne Price Nixon, Paul Michael Jones
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Brandy Leanne Price Nixon, 44, at 4:15 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, on a charge of using a false identity to avoid arrest or hinder prosecution — giving police a false name. She was in custody when the roster was read.

Fifteen minutes later, at 4:30 a.m., deputies arrested Paul Michael Jones, 48, on a charge of second-degree hindering prosecution — helping someone avoid arrest. He was released the same day. The roster does not say whether the two arrests are connected.

entries.title: Fleeing arrest: Zachary William Jones
body: Zachary William Jones, 35, was arrested by sheriff's deputies on Saturday, Oct. 31, and booked Sunday, Nov. 1, according to the jail roster.
He was booked on charges of attempting to elude a law enforcement officer — fleeing police after a signal to stop — and resisting arrest. He was in custody when the roster was read Tuesday.

entries.title: Early Sunday arrests: three booked, all released
body: Sheriff's deputies arrested Katera Amiyah Lashae Rankin, 24, at 1:20 a.m. and Jordy Armando Hernandez Chinchilla, 25, at 2:35 a.m. Sunday, Nov. 1, on charges of public intoxication, according to the jail roster.
Deputies arrested Charles Jared Yeend, 61, at 2:38 a.m. on charges of methamphetamine possession and first-offense drug paraphernalia. All three were released the same day.
